Dataset Card for Granary-HiFi
	


	
		
	
	
		Dataset Description
	

Granary-HiFi is a corpus of multilingual speech data to which complementary filtering approaches have been applied to identify high-fidelity samples. This release presents Granary-v2 enriched metadata for the VoxPopuli subset; audio bytes are not distributed in this repository.
The processing pipeline includes:

Sound event detection to identify speech coverage and filter samples contaminated by non-speech sounds.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/Granary-HiFi.
